scanNote:
101-BET. Unit 14 'Dos and Don'ts' — kasalliklar va modal fe'llar.

9a-mashqda 6 ta surat va gap pufakchasi bor. Skaner bilan tekshirildi, HAMMASI TO'G'RI:
  1 headache (boshini ushlab turgan erkak)
  2 sore throat (tomog'ini ushlab turgan erkak)
  3 cold (qaltirab, o'zini quchoqlab turgan erkak)
  4 flu (yo'talayotgan sariq sochli yigit)
  5 tired (yuzini qo'liga qo'ygan, uyqusi kelgan keksa erkak)
  6 toothache (jag'ini ushlab, boshiga bog'ich bog'lagan odam)

9b maslahatlar: aspirin=1, jumper=3, dentist=6, sleep=5, cough syrup=2, doctor+bed=4.

⚠⚠ ENG MUHIM KUZATUV — ARTIKL JAVOBNI AYTIB TURADI:
  1-pufakcha: 'I've got A ......'    → a headache
  4-pufakcha: 'I've got THE ......'  → the flu
  6-pufakcha: 'I've got ......'      → toothache (ARTIKLSIZ!)
  3 va 5-pufakcha: 'I feel very ...' → SIFAT kerak (cold, tired)

  Ya'ni taxmin qilish shart emas — gapning boshi qaysi so'z kelishini ko'rsatadi.

⚠ 'TOOTHACHE' ARTIKLSIZ — BRITANChA: Britaniya inglizchasida 'I've got toothache', 'I've got backache', 'I've got earache' — artiklsiz. Amerikachada esa 'a toothache'. Lekin 'a headache' IKKALASIDA ham artikl bilan keladi.

⚠ 11-mashq FAQAT AUDIO bilan yechiladi: kitobda jadvalning atigi bitta katagi ('keep pets' → CAN'T) belgilangan, qolgan 9 qator kassetada aytiladi. Bu audio ro'yxatida qayd etilgan.
audioRequiredUz: 11-mashqning 10 qatoridan 6 tasi KITOBNING O'ZIDAN tasdiqlanadi: 'keep pets' (kitobda berilgan), 'make the bed' / 'play loud music' / 'use the telephone' (12-mashqning namuna dialoglari), 'keep the room clean' va 'be home by 11 pm' (Grammar Book 60-bet 'must' misollari). Qolgan 4 qator FAQAT AUDIODAN aniqlanadi — ular alohida ro'yxatda ochiq qoldirildi, taxmin bilan to'ldirilmadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps in the speech bubbles with the correct words from the list.
exercises.instructionUz: Nutq pufakchalaridagi bo'shliqlarni ro'yxatdagi to'g'ri so'zlar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (6 ta so'z, har biri BIR marta):
  flu, headache, toothache, cold, tired,
  sore throat


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  1  I've got a HEADACHE.
  2  I've got a SORE THROAT.
  3  I feel very COLD.
  4  I've got the FLU.
  5  I feel very TIRED.
  6  I've got TOOTHACHE.


RASMLARDA NIMA KO'RINADI:
  1  Erkak boshini ushlab, og'riqdan yuzini
     burishtirgan          →  bosh og'rig'i
  2  Erkak tomog'ini ushlab, og'zi ochiq
                           →  tomoq og'rig'i
  3  Erkak o'zini quchoqlab, qaltirab turibdi
                           →  sovqotgan
  4  Yigit yo'talyapti, qo'lini og'ziga tutgan
                           →  gripp
  5  Keksa erkak qo'liga suyanib, ko'zlari
     yumilayapti           →  charchagan
  6  Boshi bog'langan odam yuzini ushlagan
                           →  tish og'rig'i


ENG MUHIM KALIT — ARTIKLLAR!

  Kitob har pufakchada ARTIKLNI oldindan
  bosib qo'ygan. Shuning uchun javobni
  faqat rasmga emas, ARTIKLGA qarab ham
  aniqlash mumkin:

     'I've got A ...'    → a headache
                           a sore throat
     'I've got THE ...'  → the flu
     'I've got ...'      → toothache
                           (artiklsiz!)
     'I feel very ...'   → SIFAT kerak:
                           cold, tired


NEGA HAR XIL ARTIKL — KASALLIK OTLARI QOIDASI:

  1) 'A' bilan — og'riq va oddiy kasalliklar:
        a headache      (bosh og'rig'i)
        a sore throat   (tomoq og'rig'i)
        a cold          (shamollash)
        a cough         (yo'tal)
        a temperature   (harorat)

  2) 'THE' bilan — bir nechta kasallik:
        the flu         (gripp)
        the measles     (qizamiq)
        the mumps       (tepki)

  3) ARTIKLSIZ — britancha odat:
        toothache       (tish og'rig'i)
        backache        (bel og'rig'i)
        earache         (quloq og'rig'i)
        stomachache     (qorin og'rig'i)

     DIQQAT: Amerikada bularga ham 'a'
     qo'shiladi ('a toothache').
     Kitob BRITANCHA shaklni ishlatgan.


DIQQAT — 'COLD' IKKI XIL:
  'I feel very COLD.'   → SIFAT: sovqotdim
  'I've got A COLD.'    → OT: shamollab qoldim

  Bu betda 3-rasm 'I feel very ...' shaklida,
  demak SIFAT kerak → COLD (sovqotgan).
  Rasmda odam qaltirab turibdi.


DIQQAT — 'I FEEL' + SIFAT:
  'I feel very tired.'   ✓ (SIFAT)
  'I feel very tiredly.' ✗ (RAVISH — XATO)

  'feel' — his fe'li, undan keyin SIFAT keladi
  (look, smell, taste, sound bilan bir xil —
  99-betda ko'rgan edik).


DIQQAT — 'I'VE GOT' = 'I HAVE':
  'I've got a headache.'  (britancha, og'zaki)
  'I have a headache.'    (amerikacha / rasmiy)
  Ma'nosi BIR XIL.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a headache    = bosh og'rig'i
  a sore throat = tomoq og'rig'i
  sore          = og'riyotgan, yallig'langan
  a throat      = tomoq
  the flu       = gripp (influenza)
  toothache     = tish og'rig'i
  a cold        = shamollash
  tired         = charchagan

⚠⚠ ARTIKL JAVOBNI AYTIB TURADI:

  1-pufakcha: 'I've got A ......'
     → a headache

  4-pufakcha: 'I've got THE ......'
     → the flu

  6-pufakcha: 'I've got ......'
     → toothache (ARTIKLSIZ!)

  3 va 5-pufakcha: 'I feel very ......'
     → SIFAT kerak: cold, tired

  ⚠ Ya'ni taxmin qilish shart emas —
  gapning boshiga qarang.


⚠ NEGA 'TOOTHACHE' ARTIKLSIZ?

  Britaniya inglizchasida:
     I've got TOOTHACHE   (artiklsiz)
     I've got BACKACHE    (artiklsiz)
     I've got EARACHE     (artiklsiz)

  ⚠ Amerikachada esa 'A toothache'.

  ⚠ LEKIN 'a headache' — IKKALASIDA ham
  artikl bilan keladi. Shuning uchun
  1-pufakchada 'a' bor, 6-da yo'q.

commonMistake.whyUz:
1-rasmda erkak BOSHINI ushlab turibdi.

ARTIKL KALITI: 'I've got A ...' — demak
'a' oladigan kasallik kerak:
  a headache  ✓
  the flu     ✗ ('the' kerak)
  toothache   ✗ (artiklsiz)

head + ache = bosh + og'riq

2-rasmda erkak TOMOG'INI ushlagan, og'zi ochiq.

ARTIKL KALITI: 'I've got A ...' — 'a sore
throat' ✓

'sore' = og'riyotgan, yallig'langan (SIFAT)
'throat' = tomoq

Maslahati: 'Take some cough syrup' (9b).

3-rasmda erkak o'zini QUCHOQLAB, QALTIRAB
turibdi.

KALIT: 'I FEEL very ...' — 'feel' dan keyin
SIFAT keladi. Ro'yxatda ikki sifat bor:
cold va tired.
Qaltirash → COLD.

DIQQAT — 'COLD' IKKI MA'NOLI:
  'I feel COLD'   = sovqotdim (SIFAT)
  'I've got A COLD' = shamolladim (OT)
Bu yerda birinchisi.

Maslahati: 'Put a jumper on' (9b).

4-rasmda yigit YO'TALYAPTI, qo'lini og'ziga
tutgan.

ARTIKL KALITI — ENG ANIQ BELGI:
'I've got THE ...' — ro'yxatda faqat BITTA so'z
'the' oladi: THE FLU.

  the flu    ✓
  a headache ✗ ('a' kerak)

'flu' — 'influenza' so'zining qisqartmasi.
Maslahati: 'Call the doctor and go to bed' (9b).

5-rasmda keksa erkak QO'LIGA SUYANIB, ko'zlari
yumilayapti.

KALIT: 'I FEEL very ...' + SIFAT.
3-rasm 'cold' ni olgan, demak bu yerda TIRED.

DIQQAT: 'tired' — SIFAT, 'tiredly' emas.
'feel' his fe'li bo'lgani uchun.

Maslahati: 'Get some sleep' (9b).

6-rasmda odamning BOSHI BOG'LANGAN va yuzini
ushlab turibdi — tish og'rig'ining klassik
tasviri.

ARTIKL KALITI — ENG NOZIK JOY:
'I've got ...' — ARTIKL YO'Q!
Ro'yxatda artiklsiz ishlatiladigan yagona so'z:
TOOTHACHE.

BRITANCHA QOIDA:
  toothache, backache, earache, stomachache
  — artiklsiz
Amerikada: 'a toothache' ✓

tooth + ache = tish + og'riq
Maslahati: 'See the dentist' (9b).

exercises.instructionEn: Match the pictures above to the best piece of advice in the list below.
exercises.instructionUz: Yuqoridagi rasmlarni quyidagi ro'yxatdagi eng mos maslahatga moslang.
exercises.explanationUz:
MASLAHATLAR RO'YXATI:
  Take an aspirin.            ... 1 ... (NAMUNA)
  Put a jumper on.            .......
  See the dentist.            .......
  Get some sleep.             .......
  Take some cough syrup.      .......
  Call the doctor and go to bed. .......


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
  Take an aspirin.               →  1 (NAMUNA)
  Put a jumper on.               →  3
  See the dentist.               →  6
  Get some sleep.                →  5
  Take some cough syrup.         →  2
  Call the doctor and go to bed. →  4


HAR BIRI NEGA — KASALLIK va DAVOSI:

  1  HEADACHE (bosh og'rig'i)
     →  Take an ASPIRIN.
        Aspirin — og'riq qoldiruvchi dori.
        (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

  2  SORE THROAT (tomoq og'rig'i)
     →  Take some COUGH SYRUP.
        'cough syrup' = yo'tal sharbati
        (tomoqni yumshatadi).

  3  COLD — sovqotgan
     →  Put a JUMPER on.
        'a jumper' = jemper, issiq kofta
        (britancha; Amerikada 'a sweater').

  4  FLU (gripp)
     →  CALL THE DOCTOR and GO TO BED.
        Gripp — eng jiddiy kasallik,
        shuning uchun shifokor kerak.

  5  TIRED (charchagan)
     →  Get some SLEEP.
        'get some sleep' = uxlab olmoq.

  6  TOOTHACHE (tish og'rig'i)
     →  See the DENTIST.
        'to SEE a doctor/dentist' = shifokorga
        bormoq ('to look at' EMAS).


MANTIQ — ENG JIDDIYDAN ENG YENGILGA:
  Eng jiddiy:  gripp   → shifokorni chaqirish
  O'rta:       tish    → tish shifokoriga borish
               tomoq   → sharbat ichish
               bosh    → aspirin ichish
  Eng yengil:  sovuq   → jemper kiyish
               charchoq → uxlash

  Ya'ni maslahat kasallikning JIDDIYLIGIGA
  qarab beriladi.


DIQQAT — 'PUT A JUMPER ON':
  Ajraladigan fe'l:
     'put a jumper ON'   ✓
     'put ON a jumper'   ✓
     'put IT on'         ✓
     'put on IT'         ✗

  Teskarisi — 'take off' (100-betda ko'rgandik).


DIQQAT — 'SEE THE DENTIST':
  'to SEE a doctor'   = shifokorga bormoq
  'to SEE a dentist'  = tish shifokoriga bormoq

  'see' bu yerda 'ko'rmoq' emas, 'qabuliga
  bormoq' ma'nosida.


DIQQAT — 'GET SOME SLEEP':
  'sleep' — bu yerda OT, SANALMAYDIGAN.
  'get some sleep' = uxlab olmoq.
  'a sleep' XATO.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an aspirin    = aspirin
  a jumper      = jemper (Amerikada: a sweater)
  a dentist     = tish shifokori
  cough syrup   = yo'tal sharbati
  a cough       = yo'tal (o'qilishi /kof/)
  syrup         = sharbat, shinni

pairs.whyUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA.
Aspirin — og'riq qoldiruvchi dori, bosh
og'rig'ida birinchi yordam.

'take' — dori uchun ishlatiladi:
'take a pill / take medicine'
('drink medicine' XATO).

3-rasmda odam QALTIRAB turibdi — sovqotgan.
Davosi: issiq kiyim kiyish.

'a jumper' — britancha (jemper, issiq kofta).
Amerikada 'a sweater'.

'put ON' — ajraladigan fe'l:
'put a jumper on' = 'put on a jumper'.

6-rasmda boshi bog'langan odam yuzini ushlagan —
tish og'rig'i.
Davosi: faqat tish shifokori.

'to SEE a dentist' = tish shifokoriga bormoq
('see' bu yerda 'qabuliga bormoq').

5-rasmda keksa erkakning ko'zlari yumilayapti —
charchagan.
Davosi: uyqu.

'get some sleep' = uxlab olmoq.
'sleep' bu yerda OT va SANALMAYDIGAN
('a sleep' XATO).

2-rasmda erkak TOMOG'INI ushlagan.
Davosi: tomoqni yumshatadigan sharbat.

'cough' o'qilishi /kof/ — 'gh' = /f/.
'syrup' — SANALMAYDIGAN ('some' bilan).

pairs.left: Call the doctor and go to bed.
pairs.whyUz:
4-rasmda yigit YO'TALYAPTI — gripp.
Gripp ro'yxatdagi ENG JIDDIY kasallik,
shuning uchun maslahat ham eng jiddiy:
shifokor + to'shak.

'go to BED' — artikl YO'Q (turg'un ibora,
'uxlash uchun yotmoq' ma'nosida).

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to the dialogues, then, in pairs, act out similar dialogues using the prompts from Ex. 9.
exercises.instructionUz: Dialoglarni tinglang, so'ngra juftlikda 9-mashqdagi ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib shunga o'xshash dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI IKKI NAMUNA DIALOG:

  1-DIALOG:
     A:  Tony, WHAT'S THE MATTER?
     B:  I've got a terrible headache.
     A:  WHY DON'T YOU take an aspirin?

     Tarjimasi:
     A:  Toni, nima bo'ldi?
     B:  Boshim juda qattiq og'riyapti.
     A:  Aspirin ichsangiz-chi?

  2-DIALOG:
     A:  Bob, WHAT'S WRONG WITH YOU?
     B:  I feel very tired.
     A:  YOU SHOULD get some sleep.

     Tarjimasi:
     A:  Bob, sizga nima bo'ldi?
     B:  Juda charchadim.
     A:  Uxlab olishingiz kerak.


DIALOG QOLIPI:
  A:  [ism], what's the matter? /
      what's wrong with you?
  B:  I've got a/the [kasallik]. /
      I feel very [sifat].
  A:  Why don't you [maslahat]? /
      You should [maslahat].


DIQQAT — IKKI XIL SAVOL, BIR XIL MA'NO:
  'What's the matter?'      = Nima bo'ldi?
  'What's wrong with you?'  = Sizga nima bo'ldi?

  Ikkalasi ham kasal odamdan so'raladi.
  Yana: 'What's the matter WITH YOU?'


DIQQAT — IKKI XIL MASLAHAT ShAKLI:
  1-dialogda:  'WHY DON'T YOU take ...?'
               (savol shaklida — do'stona)
  2-dialogda:  'YOU SHOULD get ...'
               (to'g'ridan-to'g'ri)

  Kitob ataylab ikkalasini ko'rsatgan —
  99-betdagi 'Giving Advice' qutisidan.


OLTITA TO'LIQ DIALOG (9-mashqning barcha
bandlari uchun):

 1  A:  What's the matter?
    B:  I've got a terrible headache.
    A:  Why don't you take an aspirin?

 2  A:  What's wrong with you?
    B:  I've got a sore throat.
    A:  You should take some cough syrup.

 3  A:  What's the matter?
    B:  I feel very cold.
    A:  Why don't you put a jumper on?

 4  A:  What's wrong with you?
    B:  I've got the flu.
    A:  You should call the doctor and go to bed.

 5  A:  What's the matter?
    B:  I feel very tired.
    A:  Why don't you get some sleep?

 6  A:  What's wrong with you?
    B:  I've got toothache.
    A:  You should see the dentist.


DIQQAT — 'TERRIBLE':
  Namunada 'a TERRIBLE headache' deyilgan.
  'terrible' = dahshatli, juda qattiq —
  kasallikni kuchaytirish uchun.

  Yana: awful, bad, splitting (bosh og'rig'i
  uchun: 'a splitting headache').


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  What's the matter?     = Nima bo'ldi?
  What's wrong with you? = Sizga nima bo'ldi?
  terrible               = dahshatli, juda qattiq
  to act out             = sahnalashtirmoq
  a prompt               = ko'rsatma, tayanch so'z

exercises.explanationUz:
GRAMMATIKA QUTISI — TO'RT MODAL

KITOBDAGI QOIDA:

 1 'We use CAN to give permission.'
      You CAN listen to the radio.
      (= You are ALLOWED to.)
      → RUXSAT BERISH

 2 'We use CAN'T to refuse permission.'
      You CAN'T keep pets in your room.
      (= You AREN'T allowed to.)
      → RUXSAT BERMASLIK

 3 'We use MUST to tell someone to do
    something.' (expressing OBLIGATION)
      You MUST clean your room.
      (= You are OBLIGED to.)
      → MAJBURIYAT

 4 'We use MUSTN'T to tell someone not to do
    something.' (expressing PROHIBITION)
      You MUSTN'T smoke in hospitals.
      (= It's FORBIDDEN.)
      → TAQIQ


TO'RTTASINI BIR JADVALDA:

            RUXSAT        MAJBURIYAT
  IJOBIY    CAN           MUST
            (mumkin)      (shart)

  SALBIY    CAN'T         MUSTN'T
            (mumkin emas) (mutlaqo mumkin emas)


ENG MUHIM FARQ — 'CAN'T' va 'MUSTN'T':

  CAN'T   — ruxsat berilmagan
            'You can't keep pets.'
            (Uy egasi ruxsat bermayapti.)

  MUSTN'T — TAQIQLANGAN, qonun/qoida
            'You mustn't smoke in hospitals.'
            (Bu — qat'iy taqiq.)

  Amalda ikkalasi ko'pincha almashib
  ishlatiladi, lekin 'mustn't' KUChLIROQ.


ENG MUHIM FARQ — 'MUSTN'T' va 'DON'T HAVE TO':

  MUSTN'T       = mutlaqo QILMASLIK kerak
     'You mustn't be late.'
     (Kechikish TAQIQLANGAN.)

  DON'T HAVE TO = qilish ShART EMAS
                  (lekin xohlasangiz mumkin)
     'You don't have to be early.'
     (Erta kelish shart emas.)

  Bu — o'zbek tilida ikkalasi ham 'kerak emas'
  deb tarjima qilinadi, shuning uchun eng
  ko'p xato qilinadigan joy!


BARCHASIDAN KEYIN — ASOSIY ShAKL:
  You can LISTEN ...      ✓
  You can TO listen ...   ✗
  You must CLEAN ...      ✓
  You must TO clean ...   ✗
  He must CLEANS ...      ✗ (-S YO'Q!)


HECH QANDAY ShAXSDA -S QO'ShILMAYDI:
  I can / you can / he can / she can /
  it can / we can / they can
  I must / you must / he must / ...

  'He cans' ✗   'She musts' ✗


SAVOL ShAKLI — 'DO' KERAK EMAS:
  Can I use the telephone?   ✓
  Do I can use ...?          ✗
  Must I make the bed?       ✓
  Do I must ...?             ✗


QISQA JAVOBLAR:
  Can I play music?
     — Yes, you CAN. / No, you CAN'T.
  Must I make the bed?
     — Yes, you MUST. / No, you NEEDN'T.
     (DIQQAT: 'No, you mustn't' — BOSHQA ma'no!
      'mustn't' = taqiq, 'needn't' = shart emas.)


'MUST' va 'HAVE TO' — 12-MAShQDAN:
  12-mashqning namunasi:
     SA: 'Do I HAVE TO make the bed?'
     SB: 'Yes, you do. You MUST make the bed.'

  Ya'ni SAVOLDA 'have to', JAVOBDA 'must'.
  Nega? Chunki 'must' savol shaklida kamroq
  ishlatiladi — 'Do I have to ...?' tabiiyroq.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  permission   = ruxsat
  to allow     = ruxsat bermoq
  allowed      = ruxsat etilgan
  to refuse    = rad etmoq
  obligation   = majburiyat
  obliged      = majbur
  prohibition  = taqiq
  forbidden    = taqiqlangan

points.en: We use can to give permission. You can listen to the radio. (You are allowed to.)
points.uz: RUXSAT BERISH uchun CAN ishlatamiz. Radio eshitishingiz mumkin. (Sizga ruxsat etilgan.)
points.noteUz: can + ASOSIY shakl ('to' YO'Q).

points.en: We use can't to refuse permission. You can't keep pets in your room. (You aren't allowed to.)
points.uz: RUXSAT BERMASLIK uchun CAN'T ishlatamiz. Xonangizda uy hayvonlarini saqlay olmaysiz. (Sizga ruxsat etilmagan.)
points.noteUz:
11-mashqda kitob 'keep pets' ni CAN'T ustuniga

points.en: We use must to tell someone to do something. (expressing obligation) You must clean your room. (You are obliged to.)
points.uz: Kimgadir biror ishni qilishni aytish uchun MUST ishlatamiz (MAJBURIYAT). Xonangizni tozalashingiz shart. (Siz majbursiz.)
points.noteUz:
Bu misol 11-mashqning 'keep the room clean'
qatorini tasdiqlaydi → MUST.

points.en: We use mustn't to tell someone not to do something. (expressing prohibition) You mustn't smoke in hospitals. (It's forbidden.)
points.uz: Kimgadir biror ishni qilmaslikni aytish uchun MUSTN'T ishlatamiz (TAQIQ). Kasalxonalarda chekish mumkin emas. (Bu taqiqlangan.)
points.noteUz:
DIQQAT: 'mustn't' (taqiq) va 'don't have to'
(shart emas) — BUTUNLAY boshqa ma'no!

exercises.instructionEn: Listen to Mrs Battersby talking to her new lodger and put a tick in the correct column. Then, make sentences using must, can't or can. — the rows confirmed by the book itself
exercises.instructionUz: Missis Battersbi yangi ijarachisi bilan gaplashayotganini tinglang va to'g'ri ustunga ✓ qo'ying. So'ngra must, can't yoki can bilan gap tuzing. — kitobning O'ZI tasdiqlagan qatorlar
exercises.explanationUz:
VAZIYAT:
  Mrs Battersby — uy egasi (landlady).
  'a lodger' = ijarachi (birovning uyida
  xona ijaraga oluvchi).
  U yangi ijarachiga UY QOIDALARINI aytyapti.


JADVALDA 10 QATOR, 3 USTUN:
  MUST  |  CAN'T  |  CAN


BU MASHQ AUDIOGA MO'LJALLANGAN, LEKIN
BETNING O'ZI 5 QATORNI TASDIQLAYDI:

 1  KEEP PETS → CAN'T
    Kitobda ✓ allaqachon qo'yilgan (NAMUNA).
    Grammatika qutisi ham aynan shu:
    'You CAN'T keep pets in your room.'
    Jadval ostidagi namuna gap ham:
    'You can't keep pets.'

 2  PLAY LOUD MUSIC → CAN'T
    12-mashqning namuna dialogi:
       SA: 'CAN I PLAY LOUD MUSIC?'
       SB: 'NO, YOU CAN'T.'

 3  USE THE TELEPHONE → CAN
    12-mashqning namuna dialogi:
       SA: 'CAN I USE THE TELEPHONE?'
       SB: 'YES, OF COURSE YOU CAN.'

 4  MAKE THE BED → MUST
    12-mashqning namuna dialogi:
       SA: 'DO I HAVE TO MAKE THE BED?'
       SB: 'Yes, you do. YOU MUST MAKE THE BED.'

 5  KEEP THE ROOM CLEAN → MUST
    Grammatika qutisining misoli:
    'You MUST CLEAN YOUR ROOM.'


QOLGAN 5 QATOR — FAQAT AUDIODAN:
  have parties in the room
  have a TV in the room
  put posters on the walls
  pay the rent on time
  be home by 11 pm

  Bular betning hech yerida yozilmagan.
  Taxmin bilan to'ldirilmadi — audio
  tinglanganda belgilanadi.
  (Ular quyidagi alohida ro'yxatda
   ko'rsatilgan.)


TASDIQLANGAN 5 QATOR UChUN TO'LIQ GAPLAR:

  You CAN'T keep pets.
  You CAN'T play loud music.
  You CAN use the telephone.
  You MUST make the bed.
  You MUST keep the room clean.


DIQQAT — JADVAL OSTIDAGI NAMUNA:
  Kitob jadval ostiga yozgan:
     'You can't keep pets.'
  Bu — birinchi qatorning to'liq gap shakli.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a lodger      = ijarachi (xona ijarasi)
  a landlady    = uy bekasi (ijaraga beruvchi)
  a landlord    = uy egasi (erkak)
  the rent      = ijara haqi
  on time       = o'z vaqtida
  a poster      = plakat
  loud          = baland (ovoz)
  to make the bed = to'shakni yig'ishtirmoq
  by 11 pm      = kechqurun 11 gacha

items.whyUz:
KITOBDA ✓ ALLAQACHON QO'YILGAN (namuna).

Uch marta tasdiqlanadi:
  1) jadvalda ✓ CAN'T ustunida
  2) grammatika qutisi:
     'You CAN'T keep pets in your room.'
  3) jadval ostidagi namuna gap:
     'You can't keep pets.'

TO'LIQ GAP: You can't keep pets.

⚠ Kitobdagi jadvalda bu qator BO'SH va betning hech yerida javobi yozilmagan — uni faqat AUDIO aytadi.
Taxmin qilib MUST/CAN'T/CAN qo'yish noto'g'ri bo'lardi.

Ijara qoidalarida bazm odatda taqiqlanadi, lekin Mrs Battersby AYNAN nima deganini faqat audio aytadi.

12-MASHQNING NAMUNA DIALOGI TASDIQLAYDI:
  SA: 'Can I play loud music?'
  SB: 'NO, YOU CAN'T.'

Mantiq ham shuni ko'rsatadi: baland musiqa
boshqa ijarachilarga xalaqit beradi.

TO'LIQ GAP: You can't play loud music.

12-MASHQNING NAMUNA DIALOGI TASDIQLAYDI:
  SA: 'Can I use the telephone?'
  SB: 'YES, OF COURSE YOU CAN.'

'of course' — ruxsatni kuchaytiradi
(ya'ni bu oddiy, muammosiz narsa).

TO'LIQ GAP: You can use the telephone.

items.textEn: have a TV in the room
items.whyUz:
⚠ Kitobdagi jadvalda bu qator BO'SH va betning hech yerida javobi yozilmagan — uni faqat AUDIO aytadi.
Taxmin qilib MUST/CAN'T/CAN qo'yish noto'g'ri bo'lardi.

Bu ruxsat ham, majburiyat ham bo'lishi mumkin — betda hech qanday ip yo'q.

GRAMMATIKA QUTISINING MISOLI TASDIQLAYDI:
  'You MUST CLEAN YOUR ROOM.'
  (= majburiyat, obligation)

Kitob 'must' ni tushuntirish uchun aynan shu
misolni tanlagan — bu tasodif emas.

'to KEEP + ot + SIFAT' = ... holatda saqlamoq:
  keep the room clean
  keep the door open

TO'LIQ GAP: You must keep the room clean.

12-MASHQNING NAMUNA DIALOGI TASDIQLAYDI:
  SA: 'Do I have to make the bed?'
  SB: 'Yes, you do. YOU MUST MAKE THE BED.'

DIQQAT: savolda 'have to', javobda 'must' —
ma'nosi bir xil, lekin savolda 'Do I have to'
tabiiyroq.

TO'LIQ GAP: You must make the bed.

⚠ Kitobdagi jadvalda bu qator BO'SH va betning hech yerida javobi yozilmagan — uni faqat AUDIO aytadi.
Taxmin qilib MUST/CAN'T/CAN qo'yish noto'g'ri bo'lardi.

Ijara uylarida bu ko'pincha taqiqlanadi, lekin betda tasdiq yo'q.

⚠ Kitobdagi jadvalda bu qator BO'SH va betning hech yerida javobi yozilmagan — uni faqat AUDIO aytadi.
Taxmin qilib MUST/CAN'T/CAN qo'yish noto'g'ri bo'lardi.

Mantiqan MUST bo'lishi kerak, lekin betda yozilmagan — taxmin qilinmadi.

GRAMMAR BOOK 60-BET TASDIQLAYDI:
'must' ning ishlatilishi tushuntirilgan joyda
kitob aynan shu misolni bergan:
  'b) for RULES —
      You MUST BE HOME BY 11 PM.'

Ya'ni uy egasining qoidasi → MUST.

DIQQAT — 'BY' va 'UNTIL' FARQI:
  'be home BY 11 pm' = 11 GACHA yetib kelish
  'stay home UNTIL 11 pm' = 11 gacha uyda TURISH

TO'LIQ GAP: You must be home by 11 pm.

exercises.instructionEn: Ex. 11 — the four rows that can only be completed from the recording
exercises.explanationUz:
OChIQ QOLGAN 4 QATOR

Quyidagi to'rtta qator betning HECH YERIDA
yozilmagan. Ularni faqat Mrs Battersby ning
nutqini tinglab aniqlash mumkin.

TAXMIN BILAN TO'LDIRILMADI — audio
tinglanganda o'zingiz belgilaysiz.


  1  have parties in the room
     (xonada bazm o'tkazish)
     MUST  /  CAN'T  /  CAN   →  ........

  2  have a TV in the room
     (xonada televizor saqlash)
     MUST  /  CAN'T  /  CAN   →  ........

  3  put posters on the walls
     (devorlarga plakat osish)
     MUST  /  CAN'T  /  CAN   →  ........

  4  pay the rent on time
     (ijara haqini o'z vaqtida to'lash)
     MUST  /  CAN'T  /  CAN   →  ........


BELGILAGANDAN KEYIN GAP TUZISH:

  Agar MUST bo'lsa:
     You MUST pay the rent on time.
  Agar CAN'T bo'lsa:
     You CAN'T have parties in the room.
  Agar CAN bo'lsa:
     You CAN have a TV in the room.


HAR BIRINING LUG'ATI:

  to have a party    = bazm o'tkazmoq
  a TV               = televizor
  a poster           = plakat
  to put ... on the walls = devorlarga osmoq
  the rent           = ijara haqi
  to pay the rent    = ijara haqini to'lamoq
  on time            = o'z vaqtida
  to be home         = uyda bo'lmoq
  by 11 pm           = kechqurun 11 GACHA


DIQQAT — 'BY' va 'UNTIL' FARQI:
  'be home BY 11 pm'
     = 11 GACHA uyga yetib kelish
       (11 dan KEChIKMASDAN)

  'stay home UNTIL 11 pm'
     = 11 GACHA uyda TURISh
       (butun vaqt davomida)

  'by' — oxirgi muddat
  'until' — davomiylik


DIQQAT — 'ON TIME' va 'IN TIME':
  'pay the rent ON TIME'
     = o'z vaqtida, belgilangan kunda
  'arrive IN TIME'
     = ulgurib, kech qolmasdan


DIQQAT — 'BE HOME' — PREDLOG YO'Q:
  'be HOME'      ✓
  'be AT home'   ✓ (ikkalasi ham to'g'ri)
  'go HOME'      ✓
  'go TO home'   ✗ (XATO!)

exercises.instructionEn: Work in pairs. Use the prompts in Ex. 11 and act out short dialogues, as in the examples.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda ishlang. 11-mashqdagi ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib, namunalardagidek qisqa dialoglar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI UCh NAMUNA DIALOG:

  1  SA: Do I HAVE TO make the bed?
     SB: Yes, you do. You MUST make the bed.

  2  SA: CAN I play loud music?
     SB: No, you CAN'T.

  3  SA: CAN I use the telephone?
     SB: Yes, of course you CAN.


TARJIMASI:
  1  SA: To'shakni yig'ishtirishim shartmi?
     SB: Ha, shart. To'shakni yig'ishtirishingiz
         kerak.
  2  SA: Baland musiqa qo'ysam bo'ladimi?
     SB: Yo'q, bo'lmaydi.
  3  SA: Telefondan foydalansam bo'ladimi?
     SB: Ha, albatta bo'ladi.


IKKI XIL SAVOL — QAY BIRINI QAChON:

  MAJBURIYAT haqida so'raganda:
     'DO I HAVE TO + fe'l?'
     → Javobi: 'Yes, you do. You MUST ...'
              yoki 'No, you don't.'

  RUXSAT so'raganda:
     'CAN I + fe'l?'
     → Javobi: 'Yes, you can.' /
              'Yes, of course you can.' /
              'No, you can't.'


DIQQAT — NEGA 'DO I HAVE TO', 'MUST I' EMAS:
  'Must I make the bed?' — grammatik jihatdan
  to'g'ri, lekin ZAMONAVIY inglizchada kam
  ishlatiladi.
  'Do I have to ...?' — ancha tabiiyroq.

  Lekin JAVOBDA 'must' ishlatiladi:
     'You MUST make the bed.'


DIQQAT — 'CAN I' va 'MAY I':
  'CAN I use the telephone?' — oddiy, og'zaki
  'MAY I use the telephone?' — RASMIY, odobli
  'COULD I use the telephone?' — juda odobli

  Kitob eng oddiy shaklni bergan.


TASDIQLANGAN 5 QATOR UChUN TO'LIQ DIALOGLAR:

 1  SA: Can I keep pets?
    SB: No, you can't.

 2  SA: Can I play loud music?
    SB: No, you can't.
         (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 3  SA: Can I use the telephone?
    SB: Yes, of course you can.
         (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 4  SA: Do I have to make the bed?
    SB: Yes, you do. You must make the bed.
         (KITOBDAGI NAMUNA)

 5  SA: Do I have to keep the room clean?
    SB: Yes, you do. You must keep the room
        clean.


QOLGAN 5 QATOR UChUN QOLIP
(audio tinglangandan keyin to'ldiriladi):

    SA: Can I have parties in the room?
    SB: ...

    SA: Can I have a TV in the room?
    SB: ...

    SA: Can I put posters on the walls?
    SB: ...

    SA: Do I have to pay the rent on time?
    SB: ...

    SA: Do I have to be home by 11 pm?
    SB: ...


QISQA JAVOBLAR JADVALI:

  SAVOL              IJOBIY JAVOB      SALBIY JAVOB
  ─────────────────  ────────────────  ─────────────
  Can I ...?         Yes, you can.     No, you can't.
                     Yes, of course
                     you can.
  Do I have to ...?  Yes, you do.      No, you don't.
                     You must ...


DIQQAT — QISQA JAVOBDA FE'L TAKRORLANMAYDI:
  'Can I play music?' — 'Yes, you can.'   ✓
  'Can I play music?' — 'Yes, you can play
                         music.'          (ortiqcha)

  Qisqa javobda faqat MODAL qoladi.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  Do I have to ...?  = ... qilishim shartmi?
  Can I ...?         = ... qilsam bo'ladimi?
  of course          = albatta
  a prompt           = tayanch so'z, ko'rsatma

groups.explanationUz: Bu betning eng muhim qoidasi: har kasallik OZ artiklini oladi.
'ache' = og'riq. Tana a'zosiga qo'shilib kasallik nomini yasaydi.
Grammatika qutisidan. Hammasidan keyin ASOSIY shakl.

patterns.exampleEn: I've got a headache. I've got the flu. I've got toothache.
patterns.exampleUz: Boshim og'riyapti. Grippga chalindim. Tishim og'riyapti.
patterns.explanationUz:
Har kasallik O'Z artiklini oladi:
  a — headache, sore throat, cold, cough
  the — flu, measles
  artiklsiz — toothache, backache, earache

patterns.exampleEn: I feel very cold. I feel very tired.
patterns.explanationUz:
'feel' — his fe'li, undan keyin SIFAT.
'I feel tiredly' — XATO.

patterns.formula: WHAT'S THE MATTER? / WHAT'S WRONG WITH YOU?
patterns.exampleEn: Tony, what's the matter? — I've got a terrible headache.
patterns.exampleUz: Toni, nima bo'ldi? — Boshim juda qattiq og'riyapti.
patterns.explanationUz:
Kasal odamdan so'raladigan ikki savol.
Ma'nosi bir xil.

patterns.exampleEn: You can use the telephone. You can't keep pets.
patterns.exampleUz: Telefondan foydalanishingiz mumkin. Uy hayvonlarini saqlay olmaysiz.
patterns.explanationUz:
can = ruxsat berish
can't = ruxsat bermaslik
Hech qanday shaxsda -S QO'SHILMAYDI.

patterns.exampleEn: You must make the bed. You mustn't smoke in hospitals.
patterns.exampleUz: To'shakni yig'ishtirishingiz kerak. Kasalxonalarda chekish mumkin emas.
patterns.explanationUz:
must = majburiyat (obligation)
mustn't = taqiq (prohibition)
DIQQAT: mustn't ≠ don't have to!

patterns.formula: CAN I + [fe'l]?  /  DO I HAVE TO + [fe'l]?
patterns.exampleEn: Can I play loud music? — No, you can't.  Do I have to make the bed? — Yes, you do.
patterns.exampleUz: Baland musiqa qo'ysam bo'ladimi? — Yo'q. To'shakni yig'ishtirishim shartmi? — Ha.
patterns.explanationUz:
'Can I ...?' — RUXSAT so'rash
'Do I have to ...?' — MAJBURIYAT so'rash
'Do I can ...?' — XATO!
